title: I COPIED KAALU'S MEOWS… AND LOOK AT HIS REACTION! 😂🐈 | Talking Cat
description:
~{ Bismillah Hir Rahman Nir Raheem }~

😂🐈 Who's copying whom? Me or Kaalu?

Kaalu started talking in his own language, so I decided to talk back! Every time he meowed, I copied him… but his reaction to my imitation was absolutely priceless! 🤣

That slow-motion look at the end says it all!

Do you think Kaalu understood what I was saying? 😂
